subject: cursor_plugins:skill:pstack/skills/poteto-mode#pr-state-as-merge-signal
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-22 (conversation), rejections re-review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3; delivered by cr-r2pa.3.9. Where the forge can be read, a pull request it reports merged for an unmerged worktree's branch is a second merge signal beside Git's ancestry, which reads a squash or rebase merge as unmerged. It counts only when the pull request merged into the audit's same base branch of the base's repository from a branch of that repository, and the worktree is then treated as propose when it is clean and its HEAD is that pull request's head commit or an ancestor of it; without forge access the audit's buckets stand (.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/worktree-cleanup.md:48-57). The proposal names the merged pull request when it was the signal (.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/worktree-cleanup.md:65-67), and removal still needs the owner's approval by name. The step lists the trait (.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/worktree-cleanup.md:5-8).

subject: mattpocock_skills:skill:skills/engineering/setup-matt-pocock-skills#pr-as-issue
why: Owner ruling 2026-11-22 (conversation), rejections re-review, bead cr-r2pa.3.3; delivered by cr-r2pa.3.8. Beads stays the authority either way (.claude/skills/triage/SKILL.md:109-117). Before any digest row is decided, triage runs its prior-rejection check and, for a pull request with no issue, searches closed beads' descriptions for its exact address, counting a match as a prior decline only when the description holds that whole address and the bead was closed wontfix, and reuses such a decline rather than recording a second (.claude/skills/triage/SKILL.md:84-91). A new decline is recorded in Beads as a wontfix-closed bead linked to the issue, or holding the pull request's address, and the row is then dismissed (.claude/skills/triage/SKILL.md:97). Our own pull request still has its body fixed through pr (.claude/skills/triage/SKILL.md:109-111). tracker sends the digest's untracked pull requests to triage (.claude/skills/tracker/SKILL.md:134-136).
